tagline: Drive the Claude Code sessions running on your other machines, and read back what they did.
summary: Remote Control lets Claude Code sessions on different machines see and message each other, but a sent message never brings its result back. remote-control-pilot closes the loop: it finds the target sessions, sends one instruction per turn with a sentinel line and a callback message, then reads the target's real transcript through RemoteTrigger get_run_log (tools called, errors hit, end of turn) so the pilot decides on evidence, not on a delivery receipt.
capabilities: Finds reachable sessions with ListAgents and resolves their claude.ai session IDs from the message envelope, the claude.ai sidebar, or the local session registry
Sends one instruction per turn with a unique sentinel line and a SendMessage callback, so completion is detectable without polling
Reads the target's condensed transcript with RemoteTrigger get_run_log and classifies it: done, running, blocked on a permission, never delivered, or errored
Runs several targets in parallel with a per-session pilot log, the pilot staying the only sender
Transfers files to a target without SSH through a private claude.ai Artifact (escaped pre blocks + SHA-256 manifest, recreated with Write on arrival)
rc-sessions.sh maps session names to bridge session IDs from the local session registry, locally or over SSH, with no dependency
